mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS bidId, b.match_id AS matchId, b.lawyer_id AS lawyerId, m.name AS lawyerName, m.job AS lawyerJob, ml.experience_years AS careerYears, b.bid_price AS bidPrice, b.status, b.message, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM match_bid b JOIN member m ON b.lawyer_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN member_lawyers ml ON b.lawyer_id = ml.user_id WHERE b.match_id = #{matchId} AND b.deleted = 1 ORDER BY b.bid_price ASC

SELECT b.id AS bidId, b.match_id AS matchId, b.lawyer_id AS lawyerId, m.name AS lawyerName, m.job AS lawyerJob, ml.experience_years AS careerYears, b.bid_price AS bidPrice, b.status, b.message, b.created_at AS createdAt FROM match_bid b JOIN member m ON b.lawyer_id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN member_lawyers ml ON b.lawyer_id = ml.user_id WHERE b.id = #{bidId} AND b.deleted = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_bid ( match_id, lawyer_id, bid_price, status, message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{matchId}, #{lawyerId}, #{bidPrice}, 'PENDING', #{message}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE match_bid SET deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{bidId} AND deleted = 1
